name: AATBS
one_liner: Licensure exam prep for mental health professionals
short_description: AATBS (Association for Advanced Training in the Behavioral Sciences) provides exam preparation materials and study programs for mental health licensure exams including LCSW, LMFT, LPCC, and...
long_description:
AATBS (Association for Advanced Training in the Behavioral Sciences) is a leading provider of exam preparation materials for mental health professional licensure exams. They offer study programs for clinical social workers (LCSW/ASWB), marriage and family therapists (LMFT/MFT), professional counselors (LPCC/LPC), and psychologists.

Their study materials include comprehensive content review, practice exams, audio programs, and online learning platforms. AATBS has helped hundreds of thousands of mental health professionals prepare for their licensing examinations over several decades in the industry.

The programs are designed to help candidates understand exam content, develop test-taking strategies, and build confidence for high-stakes licensing exams. AATBS offers different study packages at various price points to accommodate different learning preferences and budgets.

As an exam prep company, AATBS serves pre-licensed clinicians working toward initial licensure. Once licensed, clinicians typically no longer need these services unless seeking additional credentials in different disciplines.
best_for: Pre-licensed clinicians preparing for licensure exams
Social workers studying for ASWB/LCSW exams
MFT candidates preparing for licensing examinations
not_for: Already licensed clinicians (unless pursuing additional licenses)
Practices looking for staff credential tracking
